name: io.github.AIDataNordic/alexandria-mcp
description: Semantic search over 4.6 million text chunks from 20,000+ classical philosophy and humanities works — Plato, Aristotle, Kant, Nietzsche, Hegel, Hume and thousands more — sourced from Archive.org.

tools.name: search_texts
tools.description: Semantic search over 4.6 million classical philosophy and humanities texts. Supports filtering by author, language and topic with hybrid dense+sparse retrieval and cross-encoder reranking.

tools.name: get_book_list
tools.description: List books in the Alexandria collection, optionally filtered by author, subject or language.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Simple connectivity test. Returns a greeting to confirm the server is running.

prompts.name: philosopher_analysis
prompts.description: Generate a prompt for deep analysis of a philosopher's key ideas using primary sources.

prompts.name: topic_exploration
prompts.description: Generate a prompt for exploring a philosophical topic across multiple thinkers and traditions.

prompts.name: compare_philosophers
prompts.description: Generate a prompt for comparing two philosophers on a specific topic.
